summary: Iteration 16 (Smart Excel parser + Lead Time + Radar de Backlog + Resend real) fully validated. Backend pytest: 7/7 green (test_faturamento_lead_times 2/2, test_satelite_real_file 2/2, test_materials_smart_parser 3/3) + new test_resend_active 2/2 = 9/9. Resend is ACTIVE — send_email_via_resend to delivered@resend.dev returned status='sent' with id (no more 'skipped'). Frontend E2E on /faturamento: seeded a stuck project (billing_stage=ajuste_material, entered 22d ago, R$ 42.500) via motor; verified (a) 4 LeadCards render (lead-rec-fech showed '9 dias' after transitions in billing_history, others '—'), (b) 4 KPIs (Total no ciclo, Backlog=R$42.500,00, Notas emitidas, Pago), (c) preset filter 7d/15d/30d/60d/90d/Todos + fat-start/fat-end date inputs, (d) 8 kanban stages (recebimento_tecnico → pago), (e) kanban card fat-card-{id} shows red badge fat-stuck-{id}='22d parado', (f) fat-stuck-radar section renders below the kanban listing the seeded project with 'sem equipe · Ajuste de Material · R$ 42.500,00 · 22 dias parada' (data-testid=fat-stuck-item-{id}), (g) clicking fat-stuck-item-{id} opens fat-detail-modal successfully. GET /api/faturamento/pipeline schema confirmed: lead_times (dict), lead_buckets (4 keys), stuck_projects (list of {id,project_code,name,billing_stage,team_name,days_in_stage,programmed_value,entered_stage_at}), stuck_threshold_days=15. Regression: kanban + KPIs + preset filter + login all OK.
critical_code_review_comments: FaturamentoPage.jsx: preset 'Todos' generates data-testid=fat-range-Todos (capital T) — inconsistent with other lowercase ones (fat-range-7d etc). Consider normalizing to fat-range-todos for predictability, though not a bug.
server.py still 3229 lines — split into routers/faturamento.py + routers/materiais.py + services/email.py for maintainability (carried over from iter15).
PUT /projects/{id}/billing-stage still accepts arbitrary stage transitions (can go backward). Document if intentional (correction) or add order enforcement (carried over from iter15).

send_email_via_resend uses SENDER_EMAIL default 'onboarding@resend.dev' — in Resend test/free mode this only delivers to verified addresses or delivered@resend.dev. Once user verifies their domain (hayahenergy.com or similar), update SENDER_EMAIL in .env. Not a bug, but a deployment task.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (LeadCards + Radar de Backlog + kanban badge + modal open + regressão)
